title: console view tabs: a refused Delete view shows only "Delete failed" — the server's reason (now a 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT remedy for a view two packages hold) reaches console.error alone
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect with a named landing point. A refused write shows the user no reason. It is the residual delete row of the objectui#11583 write-refusal family (closed).

- **Filed by:** objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560) · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Reader who acts:** objectui triage, to grade and route. Then the `domain:ui` seat that claims it.
- **Found by:** the dev of objectui#12335 (PR #12396), reported as an out-of-scope finding in report `6181559964` on objectui#12335.

## The defect, read at objectui `main` `3f20d5aa2`

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `handleDeleteView`, at the `catch`:
  - `console.error('[ViewTabBar] Failed to delete view:', err);`
  - `toast.error(t('objectViewActions.deleteFailed'));`
  - It sends no description, so the server's refusal sentence never reaches the user.
- On the `18.0.0-next.1` server objectui resolves, the refusal for a view two packages hold is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, which names the `?package=` remedy (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23165). Other refusals (permission, a sealed item) are equally reduced to "Delete failed".
- **Measured:** the dev probed the `ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583.test.tsx` harness. The `toast.error` title read `objectViewActions.deleteFailed` and the options read `null`, where a description holding the refusal text was expected. The probe was not committed.
- **History:** objectui#11583's census recorded this row as "Delete: says objectViewActions.deleteFailed; predates this census". It closed without carrying the row.

`reach:` the console object page › a saved view's tab › Delete view, with any refusal the server returns.

## Acceptance (proposed, for triage to confirm)

- The delete-view refusal toast carries the server's sentence as its description, the same channel #11583 gave the view saves. The translated title stays.
- A pin: a refused `deleteView` shows the door's message to the user.
- ⛔ Not in scope: sending `?package=` from `deleteView`. The published `DataSource.deleteView(objectName, viewName)` signature carries no package, and adding one widens an exported member. See objectui#12335's report.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `delete view refusal toast no description deleteFailed ObjectView server message swallowed` → 6 hits, all closed. They are #11578 and #11583 (this family's save rows), #10015, #8151, #11695 and #7199. None of them carries the delete row.

Dedupe words: ObjectView delete view refusal toast no description; handleDeleteView deleteFailed door message; view delete 409 remedy swallowed.
